title: Team
description: A ClawWork team-persona template. Compiled to TS by tools/build.ts. Shared markdown skills are NOT listed here — they're discovered from the sibling files/ tree.

id.description: Stable kebab/snake-case id. Must match the directory name.

persona_id.description: Id of an existing persona under catalog/personas/.

name_suffix.description: Optional suffix appended to the persona's display name when spawned.

system_prompt.description: Replaces the persona's system_prompt entirely when this agent is spawned as part of this team. Use sparingly — prefer system_prompt_append.

system_prompt_append.description: Appended to the persona's system_prompt (with a blank line separator) when this agent is spawned as part of this team. Keeps the base persona intact while adding team-specific context.

config.description: Partial<TeamConfig> overrides — only fields that differ from defaults.
